kind_note: A standard gen_configs.py / run_experiments.py / merge_experiments.py TLSF repair campaign driven end to end by scripts/campaign.py. The factor is TLSF sweep N, with arms accoff (accumulate_repairs = false, the control) and accon (accumulate_repairs = true). Both arms state the key explicitly rather than inheriting it from the binary's default. Both levels of a seed run on the same host, the seed split being over seeds and never over levels.
question: counter emits the maximal antichain of its final population only, so a candidate that passed the output gate in an earlier generation and was not selected forward is a repair the search found and discarded. `[genetic] accumulate_repairs` (new, default false) keeps every gate-passing candidate of every generation, deduplicated and uncapped, unioned with the final population's collection before the final filters run. The campaign asks what that is worth and what it costs.
design: TLSF sweep N over the 25 families of H2H_TLSF_READY, the aurus-h2h corpus, at 4 seeds. That is 25 families x 4 seeds x 2 arms = 200 runs, av2 taking seeds 0-1 and av3 seeds 2-3. The operating point is aurus-h2h's, gen10/pop200 with nsga2-apportion selection and the log similarity metric, so these rows sit beside that campaign's. The per-spec timeout cap is 240 s and jobs = 8. Arms are paired by (spec, seed).
decision: The pre-registered rule fired in accon's favour, which is PLAN.md outcome 1. Exact McNemar over the discordant pairs of per-run implies_ideal gives p = 0.0312, rejecting at alpha 0.05. Both arms yielded on 29 pairs, neither on 65, accon alone on 6 and accoff alone on 0. The six discordant pairs are round-robin-arbiter-aurus seeds 1, 2 and 3, detector-aurus seeds 2 and 3, and simple-arbiter-aurus seed 1. Yield moved from 79 to 81 of 100. The cost bound of a median paired wall ratio at or below 1.25 cleared at a measured median of 1.034, mean 1.055 and max 1.51. Timeouts were identical at 16 per arm, so the cap censored both arms alike and the pairing holds. accumulate_repairs therefore becomes a candidate default, subject to the FRETISH replication the plan names.
decision_rule: Pre-registered in PLAN.md section 4, before any row at the campaign commit was collected. The primary endpoint is per-run implies_ideal, paired by (spec, seed) and compared by an exact McNemar test over the discordant pairs at alpha 0.05, with the run as the unit because 4 seeds makes a family rate take only five values. The cost bound is a median paired wall-time ratio at or below 1.25, above which the key stays opt-in whatever the primary says. All three outcomes were named in advance and outcome 1 is the one that arrived.
default_flip: The `genetic.accumulate_repairs` default moved from false to true on 2026-08-25, in commit e5c37d0 on branch feat/monotone-operators. This campaign's own decision made it a candidate default subject to the FRETISH replication PLAN.md names, and that replication has not been run. The flip is a deliberate departure from the condition pre-registered here, taken on this campaign's TLSF evidence alone. The FRETISH replication remains owed. The evidence it rests on is 200 paired runs at 100 (spec, seed) pairs per arm: implies_ideal gained on 6 pairs and lost on 0, exact McNemar p = 0.0312; yield 79 to 81 of 100; median paired wall ratio 1.034 against a bound of 1.25; timeouts identical at 16 per arm. RepairAccumulator never draws from the RandomSource, so the seed stream is byte-identical at either value and the flip changes only what a run emits — which still moves n_repairs, and still flips implies_ideal on a run whose good repair was lost from the final population. experiments/README.md carries the config vintage entry for the move. Reproducing any archived campaign other than this one's own two arms now means writing accumulate_repairs = false into the [genetic] table by hand.
secondary_results: Over the 84 accon runs carrying a manifest, the accumulator contributed a median of 40 repairs the final population did not hold, a mean of 46.1 and a max of 127, and contributed nothing in only 2 of them. Paired n_repairs improved in 46 pairs, was unchanged in 51 and fell in 3.
n_repairs_note: n_repairs is the wrong headline for this change, and the three falls are not regressions. The column counts the maximal antichain after the implication filter, so an accumulated repair that strictly dominates several final-population members collapses them into itself, giving a smaller and stronger output. prioritized-arbiter-aurus seed 0 went 6 to 2 and seed 1 went 2 to 1, both keeping implies_ideal. simple-arbiter-aurus seed 1 went 7 to 4 and gained implies_ideal, so it is simultaneously one of the six primary wins.

profile_commit.subject: feat(experiments): declare the 2026-08-19-accumulator campaign
profile_commit.reachable_from_main_note: campaign/accumulator merges feat/aurus-h2h, which is not an ancestor of main, so no path from main reaches this commit. That puts the campaign in the provenance/tlsf-branch position rather than the weakening-arbiter one, where main itself held every recorded sha. The archive reached main as a clean branch cut from main, chore/accumulator-archive, carrying this directory and one index row in experiments/README.md. campaign/accumulator is not merged and stays where it is, so reachable_from_main is false and is expected to stay false. The split costs no provenance here, and that was checked rather than assumed: provenance/accumulator-campaign holds every sha this file records, the profile commit a0acb0b and all four vendored_scripts blob shas, each verified reachable from the tag. CLAUDE.md warns that splitting a branch instead of merging it invalidates any recorded sha pointing into it, which is the case the tag rules out here. Merging would have cost a duplicate of the accumulator feature commit in main's history, d3f790e on the branch being the same change that reached main as 37b1f0e through PR #128. provenance/accumulator-campaign stays under the never-delete rule. With the branch unmerged the tag is now the only reference holding those shas, so it is load-bearing permanently rather than until a merge.
profile_commit.held_by_tag_note: LOAD-BEARING, COVERED BY THE NEVER-DELETE RULE. The annotated tag was created at a0acb0b and is the only reference holding it. Delete the tag and git gc collects the object, after which every blob sha under vendored_scripts stops resolving and the archive no longer names anything git can produce.

known_caveats: The 240 s per-spec cap is a budget decision and sits between aurus-h2h's p75 of 161 s and its p90 of 684 s for the same corpus. The campaign therefore cannot say whether the accumulator's advantage grows with the budget. PLAN.md section 5.1.

The archived aurus-h2h rows are context and not a control. The engine has moved since that campaign closed, through p_remove_guarantee, the MRS status grading and the crossover graft, so those rows confound the accumulator with three other changes. The accoff arm is this campaign's only control. PLAN.md section 5.2.

TLSF only. repair_mode = "muc" is inert by design, since it evolves a core sub-specification and a gate-passing candidate of one is realizable against the core alone. The FRETISH path, where accumulation is free because its generation loop already asks the gate, does not run here. PLAN.md section 5.3.

Four seeds is thin per family, and the primary draws its power from 200 paired runs rather than from within-family precision. No per-family claim should be read off this campaign. PLAN.md section 5.4.
implies_ideal is scored against counter's curated ideal set. It applies identically to both arms, so it bears on the absolute rates and not on the paired difference. PLAN.md section 5.5.
